Ash Revenant (CV 32)

A burned walking body held together by ash, stubborn sinew and an unfinished grievance. A blackened personal token identifies the wrong that prevents it from resting.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +1; Guile +0; Knowledge +0; Reason +2

HP: 32 · Speed: 6 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 2*

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2), Fire (2)\ Immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep; Frightened

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Ashen fist

The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push 2. Standard defense: Push 1.

Ashen cry

Its cry seems to come from somewhere behind your ribs.

Target: One hearing creature within 4 squares. Player defense: Reason. Damage type: None.

Weak defense: Frightened 3. Standard defense: Frightened 2. Strong defense: Frightened 1.

Shambling Advance

The corpse lurches after the nearest warm body, dragging its ruined feet without ever looking away.

Move up to 2 squares toward a visible living creature within 6 squares; its next attack against that creature before turn end imposes 1 additional Bane on the player defense. For a player-controlled creature, gain 1 attack Boon instead. It must end closer to that creature than it began. For this movement only, treat difficult ground as normal; pay other costs and provoke normally. One attack only; repeated uses do not stack. This grants no attack and cannot be used while movement is prevented.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Lifeless Body: does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

Healing: Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

Against offensive healing: controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Footprints leave soot even in running water.

Purpose: Bring one named wrongdoer to the place of the original crime.

Tactics and retreat: Push intervening guards aside and pursue the named target; accept evidence of mistaken identity.

Counterplay and conversation: Settle the wrong or expose who truly committed it.

Habitat: Burned settlement; road · Communication: None

Loot: The burned token and a clue to the old crime.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-ash-revenant

Category: Undead · Role: Relentless hunter · CV: 32

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 4/6/9

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.3

Action review (#1279): U 1.2 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0.1, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=3.000, O=5.951. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
